description: Public GO-GPT checkpoint (HF wanglab/gogpt), ten-sample frequency scoring (paper section 4.2.3 'probability' mode) on the paper's temporal test set.
command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True PYTHONPATH=src ../bin/python benchmarks/gogpt_eval.py all --decode sample --out runs/gogpt_sample10 --batch 128 --token_budget 66000 --n_samples 10 --temperature 0.7 --top_k 20 --seed 0

decoding.top_k_rule: as GOGPT.generate: logits below the k-th largest set to -inf (ties kept), softmax, multinomial
decoding.aspects: MF, BP, CC sampled independently from their start tokens, each with 10 samples
decoding.precision: fp32 (ESM2-3B layer 30 and GO decoder); bf16 was not faster in profiling
decoding.organism: species name mapped to GO-GPT organism vocabulary, unknown -> 0 (same as beam/greedy runs)
decoding.seed: torch.manual_seed(0) at the start of each generation launch; the first 1,024 shortest proteins came from a first launch that stopped on an out-of-memory error and were kept on resume
decoding.source_of_settings: T=0.7, top-k 20, 10 samples: BioReason-Pro preprint section 4.2.3 (see research_notes sota_critique.md). The GO-GPT repo has no sampling-eval script; its Lightning validation uses T=0.5, top-k 20, 100 tokens, which we did not use.
decoding.exactness_check: with top_k=1 the cached sampler reproduces the existing greedy decoder token for token (36/36 sequences)

scoring.gogpt_sample10_freq: score(term) = fraction of the 10 samples (per aspect) whose generated set contains the term; headline
scoring.gogpt_sample10_freq_prop: same, but each sample is first propagated to its ancestors in go-basic 2023-01-01 (is_a, part_of; alt ids mapped)
scoring.evaluator: cafaeval via cafa6.evaluate.evaluate (as bench_gogpt.py): go-basic_gogpt.obo (2023-01-01), CAFA-5 IA.txt, prop=max, norm=cafa, threshold step 0.01
scoring.subsets: S3_all (8,630), S6_noknowledge (8,159; excludes common_proteins.txt), identity bins from data/proc_gogpt/identity.parquet (no_hit 250, <30% 82, 30-50% 713, >=50% 7,585)
scoring.reference_rows: gogpt_beam and gogpt_greedy from runs/gogpt_cafa5, rescored in the same call (they match runs/bench_gogpt/summary.tsv)

runtime.first_launch: 1,024 shortest proteins in about 6 minutes before the out-of-memory stop

files.samples_shard0.jsonl.gz: raw samples: per protein and aspect, a list of 10 GO term lists
files.gogpt_sample10_freq.tsv.gz: protein, term, score (long format, no header)
files.gogpt_sample10_freq_prop.tsv.gz: protein, term, score for the propagated variant
files.summary.tsv: per method and subset: weighted Fmax per aspect (Fw_*), unweighted Fmax (F_*), means
files.metrics.tsv: long format with thresholds, precision/recall, coverage, Smin
